'''Amber ferns''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="TCSWE" /> Possessed of a distinct [[Color/Legends|yellow]] coloration, amber ferns were fragile and grew in clumps<ref name="Sacrifice" /> that littered the [[Galek (tree)|galek]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] forests on Mandalore.<ref name="TCSWE" />

When [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] [[Burial/Legends|buried]] the remains of his [[Death/Legends|deceased]] [[Parent/Legends|father]] and daughter—[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Ailyn Vel]], respectively—on Mandalore, he did so in a grove of galek trees where amber ferns grew in abundance.<ref name="Sacrifice" />

==Behind the scenes==
Amber ferns were first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel, ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'', written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[May 29]], [[2007]]. The following year, in [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' featured an informational entry on amber ferns.
